title: news service stage
description: Stage a new build for `service.update` (ADR 0007 decision 12). Karthik runs it in his own terminal; it re-launches elevated, copies the file to `%ProgramFiles%\News\news.exe.new` in the administrators-only install folder and records its SHA-256 in `news.exe.new.sha256` beside it. The service refuses an update whose staged build has no recorded hash or does not match it. It is Windows administration, not a Hotline action.
